verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide data export, no export formats such as CSV or JSON, and no offboarding or portability process. The settlement report covers a single payout for reconciliation, and the Balances and Chargebacks APIs are retrieval building blocks a developer could use to assemble an export. Neither is the export-and-leave capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
